name: universal-ai-skills
description: Universal CLI-first skill router and AI stack manager. Use one CLI to load 1,805 canonical skills plus indexed local external skills on demand, run audits, generate CLIs, and manage optional MCP bridges.

interface.longDescription: Use `skill-router skill <name>` to load exactly one skill when needed. Skills stay in the repository under skills/ instead of being injected into always-loaded agent context. The legacy `manus` command remains a compatibility alias.
